title: Concrete Bassline
description: A slow-burning UK speed-garage roller at 140 BPM: a rolling sine sub bass tightens and opens under a relentless 909 kick, hats and offbeat stabs stack up, and the bassline shifts shape across sections while the syncopated mids leave a pocket for a rapped vocal. Raw, dry, and driving from the first bar to the strip-down outro.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.05),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(220).gain(0.6)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.1),
    s("~ hh ~ hh").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.55).cut(1),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf("<260 340 420 520>/2").gain(0.6)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.5),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.5).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15),
    s("~ oh ~ oh").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.45).cut(1),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf("<420 600>/2").gain(0.6),
    note("<[eb3,g3] ~ [g3,bb3] ~>*2").s("square").lpf(1400).gain(0.4).attack(0.005).decay(0.12).sustain(0).pan(0.65)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.5),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.5).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15),
    s("~ oh ~ oh").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.45).cut(1),
    note("<[c1 c1 g0 c1] [eb1 eb1 c1 g0] [g0 g0 bb0 c1] [f0 f0 g0 ab0]>*2").s("sine").lpf("<700 520>/2").gain(0.6),
    note("<[eb3,g3] ~ [g3,bb3] [f3,ab3]>*2").s("square").lpf(1700).gain(0.42).attack(0.005).decay(0.12).sustain(0).pan(0.65)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf("<340 460>/2").gain(0.6),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3]>/2").s("square").lpf(900).gain(0.38).attack(0.02).decay(0.4).sustain(0.2).release(0.3),
    s("~ cp ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.45)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.15),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.52),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.52).cut(1).degradeBy(0.12).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("~ oh ~ oh").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.45).cut(1),
    note("<[c1 c1 g0 c1] [eb1 eb1 c1 g0] [g0 g0 bb0 c1] [f0 f0 g0 ab0]>*2").s("sine").lpf("<820 640 1000 720>/2").gain(0.6),
    note("<[eb3,g3] ~ [g3,bb3] [f3,ab3]>*2").s("square").lpf("<1800 2400>/2").gain(0.44).attack(0.005).decay(0.12).sustain(0).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7))
  )],
  [12, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1.05),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf("<420 260>/2").gain(0.6)
  )]
)
